newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-FLS sees 21 bln Dkk 97 turnover.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-FLS sees 21 bln Dkk 97 turnover.

text.p: Danish engineering, cement and aerospace group FLS Industries A/S said on Thursday it expected turnover to rise to approximately 21 billion crowns in 1997.

"In 1987 FLS' group turnover stood at around seven billion crowns, in the current year we are well on the way to achieving a tripling of that figure to around 21 billion crowns," FLS chief executive Birger Riisager told Reuters at a shareholders' conference.
FLS turnover rose in 1995 to 18.024 billion crowns from 14.477 billion crowns in the previous year. It is expected to be around 19.5 billion crowns in 1996.
FLS turnover was 9.334 billion crowns at half-year 1996, when the group forecast "ongoing progress" in the last six months of last year.

Risager declined to give any forecast for FLS' whole year 1996 group profit at the present stage. The company is due to issue its 1996 result at end-March. --Per Bech Thomsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-339696520
